name: ISO/IEC 27001
description: International Organization for Standardization Information Security Management System (ISMS) - Annex A Controls.

requirements.title: Policies for Information Security
requirements.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals.

requirements.title: Access Control
requirements.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and documented based on business and information security requirements.

requirements.title: Information Security Incident Management Planning
requirements.description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.

requirements.title: User Endpoint Devices
requirements.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected using endpoint management, encryption, and patch controls.

requirements.title: Privileged Access Rights
requirements.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed via multi-factor authentication and recurring review.

requirements.title: Secure Authentication
requirements.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be established based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

requirements.title: Network Security
requirements.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

requirements.title: Use of Cryptography
requirements.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
